content.title: Mere Christianity
content.author: C. S. Lewis (London: Geoffrey Bles, 1952; broadcast talks 1941–1944)
content.note: Book 2, chapter 3, 'The Shocking Alternative', gives the best-known form of the argument that Jesus' claims leave only three options. Lewis died in 1963; the book is in copyright in the US and much of the world. In copyright: described in our own words and cited by chapter or whole work, never quoted; no page numbers are given because no copy is held.
